limitations: Both synthetic cases and previous outputs were exposed development data; there are only two case clusters.
Assistant reviews were source-aware and not blinded or independent human validation.
Preserved preliminary drafts and the documented review order correction require reading the review limitations in docs/model-pilot-results.md.
No confidence intervals, significance tests, intelligence claims, size trends, model winner, or generalization claim are supported.
All requested claim slots remain in the denominator, including invalid, failed, omitted and unreviewable reports.
The completed-run view is conditional and has a smaller denominator; it does not replace all-attempt results.
Mechanical field support and assistant semantic classifications are distinct measurements.
Prose flags are counts, without an emitted-assertion denominator or an implied prose error rate.
Memory values are sampled accounting/RSS maxima, not OS peaks, and overlapping metrics must not be added.
Ollama load_duration is per-request reported nanoseconds; wall-minus-investigation time is not pure loading time.
Same-seed repeats describe execution stability, not independent task samples.
Repeat content hashes exclude runtime identifiers, timestamps and traces; log times and query scopes remain meaningful content.
Assistant-adjudicated prose counts apply only explicit cell/hash/index/quote/boolean resolutions; unchanged primary counts and secondary disagreements are retained.
Adjudication is an assistant judgment, not independent human truth validation.
purpose: Verified numeric description of two exposed synthetic development cases
review_counts_label: Unchanged primary assistant classifications and explicitly bound assistant-adjudicated prose counts are separate; secondary disagreements are retained
